en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style view of a landscaped city park with flowerbeds and small trimmed bushes surrounding a tall pedestal bearing a bust of a man. The monument stands on a grassy circular plot bordered by a low metal rail. In the background, tree-lined paths with several adults and children walking suggest a late‑19th or early‑20th‑century European urban park. The pedestal has ornate decorations and an inscription panel with the name of the commemorated person.
